Source follow-up: Published article title and DOI match supplied reference. Selected the gender × priming interaction for the Vengefulness subscale, as identified by the men-and-women locator and Study 7 Results; the whole-TRIM interaction is a distinct, marginal test (Table 3). The male simple effect is also distinct (t = 2.92, η² = .10, p < .01) and is not combined with the interaction. Analytic participant counts are retained as printed by gender; no total or effect metric was calculated. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. Replication and reported_success unassigned.
